notable: Founded 2022 by Rasmus Ankersen & Henrik Kraft, financed by Dragan Solak; owns 80% of Southampton FC, stakes in Goztepe and Valenciennes

name: Sport Venture Group
mandate: Investment and advisory firm targeting the global sports economy: franchises, infrastructure, media rights and sport-adjacent growth companies
notable: Founded 2013; has announced a $3B "Global Sport Fund" targeting institutional-scale sports asset investments

name: Sports Club Advisors Inc.
mandate: Boutique investment bank providing M&A, valuations and capital raising services to health/fitness clubs, sports and leisure businesses
notable: Founded 2015 by Jim Bates and Rich Jackim; has advised on 60+ deals worth $1B+ combined

name: Steel Sports Inc.
mandate: Subsidiary of Steel Partners Holdings that acquires and builds youth sports, training and coaching businesses nationwide
hq: Bridgewater, New Jersey, USA (parent Steel Partners HQ in New York, NY)
notable: Founded 2011; serves 100,000-150,000+ youth athletes annually; brands incl. Steel United (soccer), Team Steel (baseball/fastpitch)

name: Surj Sport Investments
mandate: Saudi Arabia's Public Investment Fund (PIF)-owned sports investment vehicle acquiring stakes in leagues, tournaments and commercial sports rights across Saudi Arabia and MENA
notable: Established 2023; CEO Danny Townsend; investments incl. Kings League, PFL (MMA), PTO triathlon, ATP Masters 1000 partnership

name: Synergy Sports Capital
mandate: Private equity acquiring controlling stakes in high-growth emerging sports leagues, teams and sports-driven ventures, esp. women's sports
notable: $150M target Fund I; founded 2026 by ex-NFL player Terrence Murphy Sr.; Reggie Bush is Partner; holdings include LOVB and Atletico Dallas

name: Teampact Ventures
mandate: VC backing mission-driven, athlete- and changemaker-founded startups (health, education, climate, sustainability)
notable: Founded 2020; 'people-first' community of athletes and leaders; portfolio incl. AZmed, Alan, Beyond Aero. Note: athlete/impact focus rather than pure sportstech

name: The Chernin Group (TCG)
mandate: Growth/PE firm building consumer businesses with strong fan bases across sports, media, entertainment, gaming and wellness
notable: Founded 2010 by Peter Chernin, Jesse Jacobs, Mike Kerns; ~$3B AUM, 112+ investments; sports is one core vertical (also media/consumer). Note: consumer-focused, not pure sportstech

name: The Collectiv
mandate: Community-powered VC fund backing early-to-growth-stage sportstech startups and emerging leagues/franchises, AI-driven fan engagement and data tech
notable: Fund I target $10M; backed by Mercury Fund and NFL star Kayvon Thibodeaux (Partner); co-investors Avenue Sports Fund, Elway Capital

name: Thirty Five Ventures
mandate: Athlete-founded family office/investment platform backing sports tech, media and consumer/fintech startups
notable: Founded 2016 by Kevin Durant & Rich Kleiman; 100+ company portfolio incl. WHOOP, Overtime, Dapper Labs/NBA Top Shot, Coinbase; Kleiman also an owner of Gotham FC (NWSL) | Why suggested: A premier athlete-led sports tech investor comparable in stature/style to Serena Ventures already on the list, but missing

name: ThrillCapital
mandate: Fan-funded venture capital backing early-stage esports/sports tech, motorsport and extreme/action sports projects via crowdfunding and equity
notable: Founded 2007 by David Tomlinson; runs ThrillCapital Motorsport Technology Fund and Perrinn 424 Le Mans EV project

name: Tipt Ventures
mandate: VC fund investing in consumer, content and enterprise businesses serving women across the sports economy
notable: Founded 2024 by Ami Galani and Fielding Jamieson; targeting $50M; first investment Ida Sports (women's cleats)

name: TitletownTech
mandate: Venture fund investing in early-stage digital, sports, media and consumer startups; JV of the Green Bay Packers and Microsoft
notable: Joint venture of the Green Bay Packers and Microsoft; Fund II raised ~$70M (2023); leverages NFL and Microsoft networks

name: TPG and Symphony Ventures
mandate: Private equity approach to sports investing, partnering with sports IP, teams and leagues for growth capital and business-building support
notable: Launched May 2025 with Rory McIlroy and Sean O'Flaherty (Symphony Ventures) as Operating Partners; anchor investment from Abu Dhabi's Lunate; past deal Troon Golf

name: Tru Skye Ventures
mandate: $100M fund targeting sports tech, fan engagement, digital media and health and wellness innovation companies
notable: Co-founded 2024 by NBA champion Metta World Peace and Stephen Stokols; investments include Barcode and FanUp

name: Varcis Capital
mandate: Asia-focused sports technology investment and advisory house investing in sport, fitness, health, wellness, eSports and human performance
notable: Launched 2019 as Asia's first sportstech VC fund; writes $500K-$5M checks across China, Australia, India, Japan, SE Asia

name: Velocity Capital Management
mandate: Private equity firm targeting lower-middle to middle-market companies across sports, media and entertainment
notable: Founded 2021 by David Abrams and Arne Rees; raising $500M debut fund; backed by Texas Permanent School Fund ($200M); investments include Elevate Sports Ventures, X Games

name: Verance Capital
mandate: Early- and growth-stage capital for companies shaping the future of sports, media and live entertainment
notable: Led by Randy Freer (ex-Hulu CEO, ex-Fox Networks); investments include Range Media Partners (sports) and Acceleration Community of Companies

name: Versus Ventures
mandate: Early-stage VC fund investing in gaming, sports technology and fintech, focused on user engagement metrics
notable: Founded by Eric Minnick; Fund I target $10M; 17+ portfolio companies including Fantasy Life and The College Sports Company

name: Wildcard Ventures
mandate: Tennis Australia's venture capital fund investing in early-stage sportstech startups impacting sports, health and entertainment
notable: Launched 2021 via Tennis Australia and Techstars; advisory backers include Greycroft, Foundry Group, Blackbird, TDM Growth Partners

name: Will Ventures
mandate: Sports-focused VC making seed and follow-on investments across media, sports betting, health and wellness, Web3 and creator economy
notable: Founded 2020 by ex-NFL player Isaiah Kacyvenski and Brian Reilly; $215M AUM across two funds; backed TGL and The Snow League

name: Wise Ventures
mandate: Early and growth-stage investor across sports and entertainment, real estate, streaming media, data analytics, fitness/health tech and gaming
notable: Founded 2018 by Minnesota Vikings owners Mark and Zygi Wilf (Wilf Innovative Sports and Entertainment); 25+ investments incl. PredictAP, exit IRIS.TV

name: X& (X&KSK)
mandate: Venture fund co-founded by footballer Keisuke Honda (X&KSK); backs early-stage startups with a sport/culture lens.
notable: ~¥15.3bn fund (2025). Athlete-founder vehicle, comparable to SC30 / Thirty Five Ventures already in the list. Added from Affinity export (Jul 2026).

name: XT Ventures
mandate: Australia's first VC fund exclusively for sport, fitness, wellness and health tech startups using Web3, AI, ML and 5G
notable: Founded 2021; raising High Performance Fund I ($50M target); cornerstone investor HCF (AU$5M); portfolio incl. EngageRM, Milo

name: XV Capital
mandate: Growth equity firm investing in global sports-tech across Human Performance, Business of Sport and Mass Participation categories
notable: Founded 2020/2021 by ex-Wallabies captain Stirling Mortlock and James Godfrey; raising $55M; partnered with Clubfunders

name: Yashaa Global Capital
mandate: Global sports VC fund deploying capital across sportstech, fitness and wellness, esports/gaming, mediatech and leagues/teams, with an Asia focus
notable: Targeting $75M incl. $25M greenshoe; backed by cricket legends Shikhar Dhawan, AB de Villiers, Ravi Shastri; formerly Da One Global Ventures; ADGM-licensed
